title: Mechanism-Level Evaluation for Vision-Language Models: Controlled Activation-Replacement Diagnosis of Gender Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Causal mediation analysis via controlled activation replacement, which involves counterfactual prompt manipulation (swapping male and female terms in occupation-related prompts) to measure the controlled indirect effect (AIE) and layer-wise sensitivity in vision-language models.

Extending the causal mediation analysis framework to multi-attribute prompts by including skin tone descriptors, measuring how the addition of skin tone attributes modulates the model's layer-wise bias pathways and computing single-attribute differentials.

Incorporating hair color and hair type descriptors into the multi-attribute prompt analysis to evaluate their interaction with gender bias signatures and to compute their specific effect differentials during activation replacement.
